topic: Someone finds out their best friend is moving across the country
text: I just learned that Alex is moving across the country. It’s a big deal, a new start, I guess. I mean, I knew things change, but this is... well, it’s a lot. We’ve been best friends since we were kids, through everything. I can’t even count the sleepovers, the secrets, the late-night phone calls. Now, those calls will have time zones. I’m not sure when it all settled in, but it’s like the floor just gave way a little. I’m trying to focus on the plans, the visits, and all the ways we can stay close. But mostly, I’m just processing, trying to wrap my head around life without Alex being a short walk or a quick drive away.
